full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the respondents herein as plaintiffs filed Other Class Suit No.27 of 2008 in the Court of Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Mymensingh for setting aside the ex-parte judgement and decree dated 26-8-1977 passed by the learned Mimsif, 2nd Court, Mymensingh in Other Class Suit No.199 of 1976 which had been filed for specific performance of contract. In the present suit they also prayed for cancellation of sale deed No.8964 dated 19-4-1979 which had been executed and registered in consequence of the said ex-parte decree, and Other Class Execution Case No.27 of 1978. The present plaintiffs also prayed for declaration that the aforesaid deed is not binding upon the plaintiffs and for declaration of title of the plaintiffs in the suit land. The plaintiffs contended, inter alia, that the suit land under CS Khatian No.413 CS Plot No.783 is in the name of Narayan Datta. 60 decimals land was recorded under SA Plot No.2390 under SA Khatian No.130 in the names of Brajeswar Datta, Biraswar Datta, Bimalaswar Datta and Biseswar Datta. Brajeswar, Biraswar and Bimalaswar died leaving behind their brother Biseswar Datta who got the land and was in possession. Biseswar Datta died leaving behind his son Ashok Kumar Datta and wife Ranuka Roy Datta. Ashok Kumar Datta sold 10 decimals land by deed No.7726 dated 2-11-1972 and 10 decimals land by deed No.8094 to Dr. Anwaruddin who died on 16-12-1975 leaving behind the plaintiffs as heirs. The plaintiffs are paying rents to the Government and municipal taxes. Ashok Kumar Datta and Ranuka Roy Datta did not sell the land described in the schedule No.3 to Syed Abu Sayeed predecessor of the defendant-petitioners and no bainapatra was executed and other Class Suit No.199 of 1976 was falsely initiated by Syed Abu Sayeed; no summons was served upon the defendants (present plaintiffs and Bhabesh Chandra Saha) in that suit and on 26-8-1977 obtained the ex-parte decree. Syed Abu Sayeed initiated Other Class Execution Case No.27 of 1978 and got registered sale deed No.8964 dated 19-4-1979 through Court in his favour; the deed is illegal. Dr. Anwaruddin was a bonafide purchaser. After death of Dr Anwaruddin the plaintiffs got the land by inheritance. On 24-4-1981 Bhabesh Chandra and plaintiff No.2 came to know about the decree dated 26-8-1977 and they clearly came to know about the decree on 28-4-1981, and filed Miscellaneous Case No.111 of 1981 in the Court of Munsif, 2nd Court, Sadar, Mymensingh under Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure (the Code) for setting aside the ex-parte decree dated 26-8-1977, which was dismissed for default on 30-4-1982. Then the plaintiffs filed Miscellaneous Case No.119 of 1982 under Order IX Rule 9 of the Code which was dismissed on 26-9-1982 holding that the miscellaneous case was not maintainable and that an appeal should have been filed. Then plaintiffs filed Civil Revision No.106 of 1982 in the Court of District Judge, Mymensingh against the order dated 26-9-1982 which on transfer to the Court of Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Mymensingh was dismissed on 27-7-1987. The plaintiffs then filed Civil Revision No.1033 of 1987 before the High Court Division and obtained Rule, which upon hearing the parties was discharged on 1-7-2008 and the plaintiffs filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.1739 of 2008 before this Division which was dismissed on 8-4-2009.
